---
title: "confounder_simulation"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


Set up the simulation


```{r}
set.seed(5500)

nsim <- 1000
n <- 1000

results <- vector("list", nsim) 

for (i in 1:nsim) {

  # Random edge strengths
  a <- runif(1, -5, 5)   # C -> X
  b <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # C -> Y
  d <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # X -> Y
  e <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # X -> M
  f <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # M -> Y

  # Simulate data
  C <- rnorm(n)
  X <- a * C + rnorm(n)
  M <- e * X + rnorm(n)

  Y <- d * X +
       f * M +
       b * C +
       rnorm(n)

  dat <- data.frame(C, X, M, Y)

  # True total effect of X on Y
  true_effect <- d + e * f

  # Models
  m_unadjusted <- lm(Y ~ X, data = dat)
  m_adjusted   <- lm(Y ~ X + C, data = dat)

  beta_unadjusted <- coef(m_unadjusted)["X"]
  beta_adjusted   <- coef(m_adjusted)["X"]

  results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    sim = i,
    true_effect = true_effect,
    estimate_unadjusted = beta_unadjusted,
    estimate_adjusted = beta_adjusted,
    abs_error_unadjusted =
      abs(beta_unadjusted - true_effect),
    abs_error_adjusted =
      abs(beta_adjusted - true_effect)
  )
}

results <- do.call(rbind, results)

```

Summarize

```{r}

mean(results$abs_error_unadjusted)
mean(results$abs_error_adjusted)

median(results$abs_error_unadjusted)
median(results$abs_error_adjusted)

```

Plot everything


```{r}


error_long <- results |>
  select(
    sim,
    abs_error_unadjusted,
    abs_error_adjusted
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("abs_error"),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "absolute_error"
  )

error_long$model <- factor(
  error_long$model,
  levels = c(
    "abs_error_unadjusted",
    "abs_error_adjusted"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Without C",
    "Adjusting for C"
  )
)

ggplot(
  error_long,
  aes(x = model, y = absolute_error)
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Absolute error in estimated total effect"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


## Effect of conditioning on mediator

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(5500)

nsim <- 1000
n <- 1000

results_m <- vector("list", nsim)

for (i in 1:nsim) {

  # Random edge strengths
  a <- runif(1, -5, 5)   # C -> X
  b <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # C -> Y
  d <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # X -> Y
  e <- runif(1, -5, 5)   # X -> M
  f <- runif(1, -5, 5)    # M -> Y

  # Simulate data
  C <- rnorm(n)

  X <- a * C + rnorm(n)

  M <- e * X + rnorm(n)

  Y <- d * X +
       f * M +
       b * C +
       rnorm(n)

  dat <- data.frame(C, X, M, Y)

  # True TOTAL effect of X on Y
  true_total_effect <- d + e * f

  # Correct adjustment for total effect
  m_without_M <- lm(Y ~ X + C, data = dat)

  # Conditions on mediator
  m_with_M <- lm(Y ~ X + C + M, data = dat)

  beta_without_M <- coef(m_without_M)["X"]
  beta_with_M    <- coef(m_with_M)["X"]

  results_m[[i]] <- data.frame(
    sim = i,
    true_total_effect = true_total_effect,

    estimate_without_M = beta_without_M,
    estimate_with_M = beta_with_M,

    abs_error_without_M =
      abs(beta_without_M - true_total_effect),

    abs_error_with_M =
      abs(beta_with_M - true_total_effect)
  )
}

results_m <- bind_rows(results_m)

results_m |>
  summarise(
    mean_error_without_M =
      mean(abs_error_without_M),

    mean_error_with_M =
      mean(abs_error_with_M),

    median_error_without_M =
      median(abs_error_without_M),

    median_error_with_M =
      median(abs_error_with_M)
  )

```

Visualize

```{r}
error_long_m <- results_m |>
  select(
    sim,
    abs_error_without_M,
    abs_error_with_M
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("abs_error"),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "absolute_error"
  )

error_long_m$model <- factor(
  error_long_m$model,
  levels = c(
    "abs_error_without_M",
    "abs_error_with_M"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Without M",
    "With M"
  )
)

ggplot(
  error_long_m,
  aes(
    x = model,
    y = absolute_error
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Absolute error in estimated direct effect"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
